description: Produces the image files for every entry on an audited art checklist, following the art bible. Writes files to the asset staging area; does not wire them into the game.
when_to_use: an art checklist exists and the images have to be made
the request is to draw, render or generate 2D images
avoid_when: the files exist and only need importing
the assets wanted are interface, effect, model or animation assets
outputs: image files in the staging area
